release_name: Looping Dual Hybrid Engine & smiledev v2.7.0 (Quantum Signature)
release_notes: Looping Engine v2.7.0 (Quantum Signature): Added native Regex Subsystem (regex.match, regex.find_all, regex.replace), HMAC-SHA256 & Random Hex (crypto.hmac_sha256, crypto.random_hex), URL Encoding (url.encode, url.decode), Data Science & Primality Math (math.median, math.variance, math.stddev, math.is_prime), System Hardware Inspection (sys.cpus, sys.version, sys.env), built-in AST Visualizer (looping ast), Source Formatter (looping fmt), Offline Reference Manual (looping doc), and smiledev doctor & run commands. Expanded C++ verification suite to 40/40 tests.
